timeline.title: 'Stalin, aka Savarkar 2.0': Vijay's TVK mocks DMK with RSS posts over delimitation bid
timeline.description: Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam recently mocked Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam chief MK Stalin through social media posts. The mockery followed DMK's support for the revised Delimitation Bill in Parliament. MK Stalin justified the decision by highlighting the Bill’s benefits for Tamil Nadu's political representation. The revised proposal utilizes the 1971 Census for determining parliamentary seats, safeguarding local interests. DMK, having previously opposed a prior version, aims to enhance Tamil Nadu's parliamentary presence.

timeline.title: Lok Sabha seat freeze is no longer linked to population stabilisation
timeline.description: The distribution of seats based on 1971 Census continued for 50 years for the reason that a readjustment would adversely affect the proportion of States that stabilised population.
